summary: Instagram bio violates brand rules (niche/region focus, free offer outside website posts). Reels lose 77% viewers in first 3s; hook failure is the weakest area. Too little data for reliable patterns (n<3 per style).
guidance:
- Hook style to try next: **contrast** (1.75x median, n=1) or **comparison** (1.29x, n=3) — rotate away from **question** (weak signal: earns 24% of comparison per reach).
- Avoid repeating "high-end video ads without camera crew" and "why brands look high-end" — both animated_ads posts used similar budget-angle; vary the pain point.
- Posts must read as a developer showing real work: share a code snippet, a frame from an actual render, or a brief technical decision — never promise outcomes or use ad copy.

instructions.research: Find 2-3 Indian small-business Instagram reels (any industry) that use motion graphics/text animation instead of footage; note their first 3 seconds.
instructions.analysis: Compare the skip-rate of your last animated_ads reel (77%) to the reference reels; identify one visual or audio cue they use in the first second that you didn't.
instructions.writer: Write a 90-120 word carousel caption using a **contrast** hook: show a static poster vs. the same offer as an animated ad, explain the technical difference (e.g., Lottie vs. MP4), end with "Pay after you approve the final file."
instructions.image: Create a 2-slide carousel: slide 1 = static poster (any generic festival sale), slide 2 = the same poster with subtle motion (price badge pulse, CTA arrow slide). Export as 1080x1080 PNGs.
instructions.video: Do not shoot video today. Prepare a 5-second screen-record of the animation timeline in your editor (After Effects / Rive / CSS) for a future reel.

manual_tips: Update Instagram bio to: "AI chatbots, animated ads, lead sheets & websites for small businesses across India. Pay after approval. DM for a quick chat."
Comment thoughtfully on 3 posts from Indian freelancers/agencies discussing client acquisition or ad creative — no self-promo.
Reply to every story mention or tag within 2 hours; keep replies conversational, not salesy.
